title: Fresh init: right_now.enabled true with ai null warns on every create
description:
Fresh init produced:
  right_now:
    enabled: true
  ai: null

Every kbs create then warned:
  right-now generation requires ai.provider litellm in .kanbus.yml

Expected: Fresh projects should either default right_now.enabled to false when no AI provider exists, or silently skip generation until configured.
right_now_summary: Fresh projects warn on every create because right_now is enabled without an AI provider.
